uat.reason: No approved isolated UAT profile, target, identities, fixtures, or Wave 7 approval

live_staging.reason: Required deployment and staging checks NOT TESTED

public_production.reason: Prior gates failed, blocked, missing, or unverified

required_prerequisites.required: Approver, approval reference, selected checks, environment, time window, and explicit bounded read-only authorization
Named owner and least-privilege private secret-store reference for each selected credential class; no values in artifacts
Exact approved API/portal/VPS target, Supabase project reference, release/build identity, tenant/fixture scope, selected checks, and exclusions
Current isolated UAT evidence where required, including target, identities, fixtures, cleanup, and rollback ownership
Current rerun or replacement evidence for failed/stale local and UAT gates against the selected release revision
UTC start/end, operator, change-freeze boundary, and automatic stop deadline
Named observer, health/alert signals, alert route, correlation ID, and stop authority
Approved redacted relative destination, retention, manifest owner, source revision, check IDs, and cost/cleanup record

approved_non_destructive_checks: read-only schema and migration lineage comparison
read-only RLS and tenant-isolation checks with approved identities
read-only runtime, queue, worker, and observability health
read-only or test-mode billing state without charge/cancellation
explicitly selected provider dry-run/status checks within budget
email verification/status only unless a separate test-only send/receive approval exists

required_budgets.note: UAT example caps are not live authorization

cleanup.required: Named owner, temporary-resource cleanup, retention, verification, and no-side-effect abort procedure

rollback_recovery.required: Approved deployment/runtime recovery runbook, decision authority, and backup/restore or forward-fix plan for any separately approved mutation

evidence.required: Separate live manifest with environment, source revision, scope, check results, redaction, costs, cleanup, and limitations
